comment: Hand-authored BLiMP-style grammaticality minimal pairs for the Workstream C guard battery (nextsteps §7.2). Each pair differs in exactly one word; 'good' is grammatical. Authored in-repo so the source is pinned by git; no external dataset carries these exact sentences.

pairs.good: The keys to the old cabinet are lying on the kitchen table.
pairs.bad: The keys to the old cabinet is lying on the kitchen table.

pairs.good: The pattern of cracks along these walls suggests a foundation problem.
pairs.bad: The pattern of cracks along these walls suggest a foundation problem.

pairs.good: Neither of the candidates was prepared for the final question.
pairs.bad: Neither of the candidates were prepared for the final question.

pairs.good: She adopted these kittens from the shelter last spring.
pairs.bad: She adopted this kittens from the shelter last spring.

pairs.good: Every student in the seminar submitted an outline before the deadline.
pairs.bad: Every students in the seminar submitted an outline before the deadline.

pairs.good: The director praised herself after the successful premiere.
pairs.bad: The director praised themself after the successful premiere.

pairs.good: The twins taught themselves to read before starting school.
pairs.bad: The twins taught himself to read before starting school.

pairs.good: The glass fell from the shelf and broke into pieces.
pairs.bad: The glass fell from the shelf and breaked into pieces.

pairs.good: The children swam across the shallow end of the pool.
pairs.bad: The children swimmed across the shallow end of the pool.

pairs.good: Nobody in the audience had ever seen the play performed live.
pairs.bad: Everybody in the audience had ever seen the play performed live.

pairs.good: She rarely says anything during the weekly planning meetings.
pairs.bad: She often says anything during the weekly planning meetings.

pairs.good: The comedian amused the crowd with an improvised story.
pairs.bad: The comedian vanished the crowd with an improvised story.

pairs.good: The letter arrived two weeks after it was posted.
pairs.bad: The letter devoured two weeks after it was posted.

pairs.good: By Friday the committee will have reviewed every application.
pairs.bad: By Friday the committee will has reviewed every application.

pairs.good: The engineers should have checked the valve before the test.
pairs.bad: The engineers should has checked the valve before the test.

pairs.good: The manager asked him to lock the storeroom at closing time.
pairs.bad: The manager asked he to lock the storeroom at closing time.

pairs.good: Between you and me, the second proposal was far stronger.
pairs.bad: Between you and I, the second proposal was far stronger.

pairs.good: This is the recipe that my grandmother perfected over decades.
pairs.bad: This is the recipe that my grandmother perfected it over decades.

pairs.good: The article that the editor rejected was later published elsewhere.
pairs.bad: The article that the editor rejected the draft was later published elsewhere.

pairs.good: The northern route is much longer than the coastal one.
pairs.bad: The northern route is much more longer than the coastal one.
